import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {createChinaNumericReadiness,resolveChinaNumericReadiness} from './readiness-binder.mjs';
test('numeric readiness is not a supplied callback/report/boolean',()=>{assert.throws(()=>createChinaNumericReadiness({nativeSession:{},storage:{},publisherRoot:'/unused'}),/session_capability/);assert.throws(()=>resolveChinaNumericReadiness({afterNativePrepared:async()=>true},{storage:{},publisherRoot:'/unused',runtimeRoot:'/unused',release:'a'.repeat(40)}),/numeric_readiness_capability/);});

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs/promises';import os from 'node:os';import path from 'node:path';import {createTransportReceipts} from './transport-receipts.mjs';
test('narrow transport receipt retains both values without arbitrary data',async()=>{const root=await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'numeric-transport-'));const d=path.join(root,'evidence');const w=await createTransportReceipts({directory:d,generationId:'gen_123_abc'});await w.sink({ordinal:1,beforeBorderRub:0,beforeExcludedRub:0,afterBorderRub:127500,afterExcludedRub:127500,boundLogisticsRub:127500,raw:'must-not-store'});await assert.rejects(w.sink({ordinal:2,beforeBorderRub:0,beforeExcludedRub:0,afterBorderRub:127500,afterExcludedRub:1,boundLogisticsRub:127500}),/numeric_transport_case/);const receipt=await w.finish();const text=await fs.readFile(path.join(d,receipt.file),'utf8');assert.equal(receipt.rows,1);assert.equal(text.includes('must-not-store'),false);assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(text.trim().split('\n')[1]),{ordinal:1,beforeBorderRub:0,beforeExcludedRub:0,afterBorderRub:127500,afterExcludedRub:127500,boundLogisticsRub:127500});});

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import{parseLinuxMemoryAvailable,readRunnerResources}from'./runner-resources.mjs';
test('MemAvailable includes reclaimable cache, not merely MemFree',()=>{assert.deepEqual(parseLinuxMemoryAvailable('MemTotal: 16384 kB
MemFree: 128 kB
MemAvailable: 12288 kB
'),{totalBytes:16777216,availableBytes:12582912});});
test('missing, duplicated, malformed, wrong unit, overflow and impossible availability fail closed',()=>{for(const text of ['MemTotal: 10 kB
','MemTotal: 10 kB
MemAvailable: 1 kB
MemAvailable: 2 kB
','MemTotal: 10 kB
MemAvailable: -1 kB
','MemTotal: 10 kB
MemAvailable: 1 MB
','MemTotal: 999999999999999999999 kB
MemAvailable: 1 kB
','MemTotal: 10 kB
MemAvailable: 11 kB
','x'.repeat(65537)])assert.throws(()=>parseLinuxMemoryAvailable(text),/resource_/);});
test('actual local Linux read-only resource evidence exposes verified available memory',async()=>{const r=await readRunnerResources({workspace:process.cwd(),temp:'/tmp'});assert.equal(r.memory.availableStatus,'verified');assert(Number.isSafeInteger(r.memory.availableBytes));assert(r.memory.availableBytes>=0);assert(r.memory.availableBytes<=r.memory.meminfoTotalBytes);assert.equal(r.executionAuthorized,false);});
